name: Donyi
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Donyi argues for a shared political identity among Pragjyotisha’s valley and hill communities. A public calendar gives the new polity common civic dates while leaving room for local seasonal reckoning. The University register proposes a connection to Pragjyotisha Adopts the Twin Reckoning. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
